claim: Requests for aggregated data used in pilot operations may follow a simplified procedure.
Access to 15-minute readings, meter identifiers, or combinations that could reveal consumption habits will require full review and additional justification.
Every exception must include an expiry date and a person responsible for follow-up.
It remains undecided whether the committee requires unanimity or a simple majority.
Andrés proposes a majority of two of its three members, provided that the privacy representative participates.
Sergio will prepare the request form and a decision log.
No access should remain active after its declared purpose has ended.
